product_name: Symantec SWG (Symantec Edge SWG, Symantec Cloud SWG)
product_brief: Secure Web Gateway providing centralized enforcement and quantum-ready security at the network edge.
pqc_capability_description: Supports Module Lattice Key Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) hybrid key exchange methods, such as X25519MLKEM768. Implements quantum-safe key exchange at the proxy layer to strengthen encryption transparently without requiring changes from end users or endpoint devices.
crypto_primitives: X25519, ML-KEM (Module Lattice Key Encapsulation Mechanism)
key_management_model: Hybrid key exchange at the proxy layer
pqc_roadmap_details: Supports incremental adoption of PQC using hybrid methods (X25519MLKEM768) to maintain compatibility with existing environments while aligning with emerging cryptographic standards.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Low friction; incremental adoption; no disruptive rip-and-replace; maintains compatibility with existing applications and infrastructure; no changes required for end users or endpoint devices.

product_brief: Next-generation Unified Endpoint Management platform for Apple, Android, and Windows devices.
pqc_capability_description: Live implementation of Post-Quantum Hybrid Public Key Encryption (HPKE) using X25519MLKEM768 for key exchange in MDM communication. Secures data in transit for iOS 26, macOS 26, and iPadOS 26. Uses TLS 1.3 via OpenSSL 3.5.0 on server side and Apple’s quantum-secure TLS 1.3 APIs on client side. Symmetric encryption uses AES-256.
crypto_primitives: X25519, ML-KEM-768, AES-256, RSA, Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC)
pqc_roadmap_details: Expanding PQC support for Android and Windows devices; developing PQC-aware compliance checks.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Zero disruption; requires no action from IT teams; seamless transition.

product_brief: LTO-10 is the newest format specification for LTO Ultrium tape drives and media, offering increased capacity and quantum-safe encryption.
pqc_capability_description: LTO-10 hardware-based encryption utilizes quantum-safe AES/GCM256 symmetric keys and is post-quantum cryptography key exchange ready.
primary_platforms: LTO Ultrium tape drives and media
pqc_roadmap_details: LTO-10 is post-quantum cryptography key exchange ready.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Backwards compatibility is not supported in LTO-10.

product_brief: NAS operating system with PQC Hybrid TLS encryption, enhanced firewall, and AI photo features.
pqc_capability_description: ADM 5.1 supports PQC Hybrid TLS encryption certified by US NIST. It adopts the Kyber algorithm (X25519+ML-KEM 768). The feature is automatically enabled through TLS 1.3 without configuration, protecting against "Harvest Now, Decrypt Later" threats.
pqc_roadmap_details: ADM 5.1 and later automatically enable PQC Hybrid TLS (X25519+ML-KEM 768) via TLS 1.3.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: It will no longer be possible to downgrade to a previous version after installing ADM 5.1.

product_brief: PQC-ready European Business Wallet (EUBW) solution for digital identity and data security in critical infrastructure.
pqc_capability_description: Spherity delivers quantum-ready identity solutions and PQC-ready European Business Wallet (EUBW) solutions. The company contributes to the EU’s “We Build” Large Scale Pilot, addressing PQC requirements for identity and data security. It integrates PQC into decentralized identity solutions, ensuring robust, future-proof protection against quantum threats.
crypto_primitives: RSA, ECC, ECDSA, DSA, SHA-256, SHA-3, AES, Diffie–Hellman
target_industries: Critical Infrastructure, Energy, Healthcare, Finance, Transport, Supply Chain, Smart Cities, Industry 4.0, Government
pqc_roadmap_details: Spherity is actively contributing to the EU’s “We Build” Large Scale Pilot to ensure organizations are prepared for the quantum era. The energy data-X project already implements PQC within the EUBW-ready wallet solution.
